paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates execution accuracy for two logical synthesis modules, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four complexity levels. The horizontal axis represents the complexity levels: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, displayed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Execution Accuracy" and ranges from 0 to 63.14, with tick labels displayed at intervals of 10. Each complexity level has two bars representing NatSQL and TA-SQL, colored light blue and dark blue respectively. The NatSQL bar for the Simple complexity level exhibits an approximate value of 60.21, while the TA-SQL bar for the same complexity level has a value of 56.19. For the Moderate complexity level, the NatSQL bar shows a value of approximately 39.64, and the TA-SQL bar displays a value around 36.11.  The Challenging complexity level bars are shorter, with NatSQL at approximately 32.32 and TA-SQL at approximately 36.11. The Total complexity level bars show NatSQL with a value of approximately 48.60 and TA-SQL with approximately 51.35. The bars are not sorted in an apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color distinction. Values are annotated directly above each bar.
